title: Data and AI Governance, Senior Manager
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam is building an AI-ready, agentic data governance program designed to make trusted data accessible, reliable, and actionable across the enterprise. As data flows through our Databricks Lakehouse into executive reporting and AI-powered applications, we're transforming how data governance operates through automation, continuous trust measurement, and intelligent workflows. We are now looking for a Data and AI Governance, Senior Manager to help turn this vision into a scalable, operational reality. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance, you'll play a critical hands-on role in designing, building, and operating the technical capabilities behind Veeam's data governance strategy. You'll develop AI agents, automated governance workflows, catalog integrations, trust-scoring systems, and intelligent escalation mechanisms that make governance continuous rather than a one-time exercise. This is a senior individual-contributor position offering significant technical ownership and the opportunity to shape how AI-enabled governance operates across the organization. You'll partner closely with the Senior Director, who owns the overall strategy and program direction, while bringing your own technical judgment, curiosity, and experimentation to the implementation. We're looking for someone who enjoys building solutions, exploring emerging AI capabilities, and replacing manual governance activities with intelligent automation. This is not a traditional policy-administration, catalog-maintenance, or people-management role. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate Veeam's AI-ready Data Governance and Trust Operating Process within the Governance Hub, our centralized platform for governance automation, monitoring, and reporting. Develop automated data discovery and lineage capabilities to identify authoritative data sources, critical data assets, and key business fields, validating how information flows from enterprise systems through the Databricks Lakehouse to downstream analytics and AI applications. Build governance workflows that establish clear data ownership, business definitions, usage context, and accountability, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve ambiguities and implement consistent standards across business domains. Design and implement continuous, AI-driven data trust scoring systems that evaluate data against defined quality and governance dimensions, determine Trust Tiers, and surface risks, exceptions, and recommended actions through Daily Intelligence and Executive KRI Reporting. Develop automated notification, escalation, and remediation workflows that identify declining data trust, alert accountable owners, protect downstream consumption when necessary, and track issues through resolution. Lead the technical implementation and integration of Databricks Unity Catalog and business-facing data catalog platforms such as Atlan, establishing metadata management, lineage, tagging, access controls, ownership, and certification workflows. Build, register, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated pipelines that perform governance activities within defined security boundaries, access permissions, and operational guardrails. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Data Engineering to translate governance requirements into scalable, automated solutions that support enterprise reporting and AI adoption. Experiment with emerging agentic AI capabilities, including new automation patterns and development tools, evaluating effectiveness, adoption, and business impact to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Lead complex, cross-functional governance initiatives from technical design through implementation and ongoing operation, balancing competing priorities and adapting solutions as business needs evolve. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to colleagues and data stewards, promoting reusable automation patterns, governance best practices, and the adoption of AI-enabled ways of working. Continuously improve governance effectiveness by monitoring data trust, automation performance, stakeholder adoption, and operational outcomes, proactively recommending enhancements aligned with business priorities. title: Director, Recruiting Operations
description: The Director of Recruiting Operations and Systems will lead the strategy, evolution, and execution of the technology, systems, and operating model that powers hiring across Datadog. This leader will oversee Recruiting Operations, Recruiting Technology, and AI Enablement for the recruiting team. You will be a key player leading a team that supports a recruiting function of approximately 200 recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators. We are undergoing an exciting transformation across our People and Recruiting teams, and we need a leader who can bring expertise in recruiting, systems, and data, along with a product management mindset, to help build the best experience for our candidates, recruiting teams, and interviewers. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. Lead multidisciplinary teams to move us from a traditional recruiting operations approach to a more progressive, AI-native approach.  Apply product management principles to continually gather user feedback and use it to drive experimentation, new tool investments, and workflow improvements. Establish responsible AI governance while driving automation initiatives that improve recruiter productivity, hiring quality, and operational efficiency. Partner with our People Analytics teams to ensure that the workflows in our recruiting systems provide the data needed to drive critical business decisions and train recruiting teams on how to use these tools for better hiring partnerships. Partner with Recruiting, Engineering, IT, Security, Finance, People Technology, and executive stakeholders to drive platform adoption, continuous improvement, and organizational change, while ensuring that we continually comply with applicable laws and regulations governing the use of AI in hiring decisions globally.   Who You Are: Significant leadership experience driving enterprise-scale recruiting operations, people technology, product management, business operations, or comparable platform organizations. Proven success leading complex technology, systems, or operational transformation initiatives with measurable business impact. Strong experience managing recruiting vendors, maintaining awareness of the solutions available in the market, and developing deep expertise in areas such as ATS configuration, Workday-to-Greenhouse connections and data flows, API issue resolution, integrations, and low-code agentic or workflow automation tools such as Workato.  Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills with the ability to translate data into product priorities and executive decisions. You should be able to spot trends in recruiting data and propose ways in which your team can provide support. Experience leading managers and individual contributors. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leaders across multiple functions. Passionate about building scalable systems, developing high-performing teams, and creating exceptional user experiences through continuous improvement. Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know that not everyone will meet all of the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply. Benefits and Growth: Lead the strategy for one of the company's most critical enterprise platforms, directly influencing how talent is hired at scale. Shape the future of AI-enabled recruiting by introducing innovative technologies, automation, and intelligent workflows. Partner with senior leaders across the business to influence company-wide hiring strategy and operational excellence. Build and mentor a multidisciplinary organization spanning operations, technology, analytics, and AI capabilities. Drive meaningful business impact through measurable improvements in hiring quality, recruiter productivity, and platform adoption. Join a culture that values experimentation, continuous learning, and customer-centered product thinking. title: Commercial Counsel
description: About the Role Together AI is looking for a Commercial Counsel to support the deals that drive our growth. You’ll work alongside the Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Product, and Security teams as the legal partner who helps each of them move quickly while keeping risk in view. What we sell sits at the core of our customers’ own products, so our commercial deals call for a real understanding of how the technology works. The terms we agree to with customers and partners shape our relationships and our business for years. This role suits a lawyer who wants to be a true business partner to a fast-moving sales organization, rather than working within a narrow contracts lane. Responsibilities Sales Serve as the legal point of contact for Sales across enterprise customer deals, managing commercial agreements including master agreements, order forms, data processing terms, security exhibits, and NDAs. Negotiate customer contracts end to end, partnering closely with Sales, Security, Product, and Finance to resolve issues quickly and keep deals moving through the pipeline. Advise Sales on risk, contract positions, and fallback terms, and manage escalations on non-standard requests such as custom SLAs, data protection obligations, and liability and indemnity terms. Build the templates, playbooks, and scalable workflows that make Sales deals repeatable, including standard forms, negotiation playbooks, and clear escalation paths. Partnerships Structure and negotiate go-to-market and partnership deals, including collaboration, reseller, licensing, and co-sell arrangements. Work with Sales, Partnerships, and Product to align partner terms with business goals, customer commitments, and company risk posture. Develop standard partnership templates and default negotiating positions so routine partner deals can move quickly and consistently. Requirements A JD and an active bar license in good standing At least 5 years in commercial and technology transactions, including substantial in-house time at an infrastructure company Experience supporting deals for purchasing compute and critical infrastructure, partner and strategic alliances agreements, and enterprise commercial deals A working command of data privacy (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA) and regulatory (EU AI Act, EU Data Act, DORA) regimes and security terms (data processing agreements, security addenda) Familiarity with export controls and the regulatory requirements that apply to partners and counterparties, such as the FCPA and other anti-bribery and anti-corruption regimes A plain-spoken style that makes legal and technical points accessible to non-lawyers Comfort working independently in a small, fast-moving legal team, with sound instincts for what to own, what to escalate, and when to bring in specialized outside counsel Desire for learning and building with AI tools so you can operate self-sufficiently and at speed About Together AI Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month. Compensation We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $200-230K + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
